title_en: must, need, should, have to, had better and ought to (Exercises 73–82)
title_vi: must, need, should, have to, had better và ought to
theory_html:
A. Exercises in this group

A. Các bài tập trong nhóm

Exercise 73: Match the beginning of each sentence with the most suitable ending.

Bài 73: Nối phần đầu mỗi câu với phần kết phù hợp nhất.

Exercise 74: Choose the correct alternative.

Bài 74: Chọn phương án đúng.

Exercise 75: For each pair of sentences, write same if sentences a and b have the same meaning. If the meaning is different, try to explain.

Bài 75: Với mỗi cặp câu, viết same nếu câu a và b cùng nghĩa. Nếu khác nghĩa, hãy thử giải thích.

Exercise 76: Complete the sentences with must(n’t), need(n’t) or should(n’t).

Bài 76: Hoàn thành câu với must(n’t), need(n’t) hoặc should(n’t).

Exercise 77: Read the rules of the Fitness Centre. Complete what the instructor says with must(n’t), need(n’t) or should(n’t).

Bài 77: Đọc nội quy phòng tập. Hoàn thành lời huấn luyện viên với must(n’t), need(n’t) hoặc should(n’t).

Exercise 78: Read what James did. Then complete what the instructor says with must(n’t), need(n’t) or should(n’t).

Bài 78: Đọc những gì James đã làm. Rồi hoàn thành lời huấn luyện viên với must(n’t), need(n’t) hoặc should(n’t).

Exercise 79: Read the situations and write sentences with ought (not) to. Some of the sentences are past and some are present.

Bài 79: Đọc tình huống và viết câu với ought (not) to. Có câu ở quá khứ, có câu ở hiện tại.

Exercise 80: Tick the correct sentence in each pair, or tick both if both are correct.

Bài 80: Đánh dấu câu đúng trong mỗi cặp, hoặc cả hai nếu cả hai đều đúng.

Exercise 81: Complete the email with had better, should or have to. Sometimes there is more than one answer.

Bài 81: Hoàn thành email với had better, should hoặc have to. Đôi khi có nhiều hơn một đáp án.

Exercise 82: Complete the second sentence with (don’t) have to, should(n’t) or had better (not) so that it has a similar meaning to the first.

Bài 82: Hoàn thành câu thứ hai với (don’t) have to, should(n’t) hoặc had better (not) sao cho nghĩa tương tự câu đầu.

B. Related units

B. Các unit liên quan

English Grammar in Use, Units 31–33 and 35 (theory below).

English Grammar in Use, Unit 31–33 và 35 (lý thuyết bên dưới).

mcq.question: Lucy should be having breakfast, ___.
mcq.a: but she’s too nervous to eat
mcq.b: when she was supposed to be studying
mcq.full: Lucy should be having breakfast, but she’s too nervous to eat.
mcq.vi: Lucy lẽ ra đang ăn sáng, nhưng cô ấy quá hồi hộp nên không ăn nổi.
mcq.expl:
should (be doing) = what is right now; shouldn’t have done = it was wrong (past); mustn’t = it is important not to; doesn’t have to = it isn’t necessary; didn’t need to = it wasn’t necessary (so she didn’t); needn’t have done = she did it, but it wasn’t necessary.
should (be doing) = điều nên làm lúc này; shouldn’t have done = việc đó sai (quá khứ); mustn’t = quan trọng là không được; doesn’t have to = không cần; didn’t need to = không cần (nên đã không làm); needn’t have done = đã làm nhưng không cần thiết.
Điểm ngữ pháp: should be having (hiện tại) ↔ but she’s too nervous to eat.
mcq.key: Lucy should be having breakfast, ___.|but she’s too nervous to eat

mcq.question: Millie shouldn’t stay up all night ___.
mcq.a: when she has an exam the next day
mcq.b: when she was supposed to be studying
mcq.full: Millie shouldn’t stay up all night when she has an exam the next day.
mcq.vi: Millie không nên thức trắng đêm khi hôm sau cô ấy có bài thi.
mcq.expl:
should (be doing) = what is right now; shouldn’t have done = it was wrong (past); mustn’t = it is important not to; doesn’t have to = it isn’t necessary; didn’t need to = it wasn’t necessary (so she didn’t); needn’t have done = she did it, but it wasn’t necessary.
should (be doing) = điều nên làm lúc này; shouldn’t have done = việc đó sai (quá khứ); mustn’t = quan trọng là không được; doesn’t have to = không cần; didn’t need to = không cần (nên đã không làm); needn’t have done = đã làm nhưng không cần thiết.
Điểm ngữ pháp: shouldn’t + V (lời khuyên chung) ↔ when she has an exam.
mcq.key: Millie shouldn’t stay up all night ___.|when she has an exam the next day

mcq.question: Jenny shouldn’t have gone out ___.
mcq.a: when she was supposed to be studying
mcq.b: or she’ll be late for her interview
mcq.c: if she’s not going to work today
mcq.full: Jenny shouldn’t have gone out when she was supposed to be studying.
mcq.vi: Jenny lẽ ra không nên ra ngoài khi cô ấy phải học bài.
mcq.expl:
should (be doing) = what is right now; shouldn’t have done = it was wrong (past); mustn’t = it is important not to; doesn’t have to = it isn’t necessary; didn’t need to = it wasn’t necessary (so she didn’t); needn’t have done = she did it, but it wasn’t necessary.
should (be doing) = điều nên làm lúc này; shouldn’t have done = việc đó sai (quá khứ); mustn’t = quan trọng là không được; doesn’t have to = không cần; didn’t need to = không cần (nên đã không làm); needn’t have done = đã làm nhưng không cần thiết.
Điểm ngữ pháp: shouldn’t have gone (quá khứ) ↔ when she was supposed to be studying.
mcq.key: Jenny shouldn’t have gone out ___.|when she was supposed to be studying

mcq.question: Megan mustn’t oversleep, ___.
mcq.a: or she’ll be late for her interview
mcq.b: when she was supposed to be studying
mcq.full: Megan mustn’t oversleep, or she’ll be late for her interview.
mcq.vi: Megan không được ngủ quên, nếu không cô ấy sẽ trễ buổi phỏng vấn.
mcq.expl:
should (be doing) = what is right now; shouldn’t have done = it was wrong (past); mustn’t = it is important not to; doesn’t have to = it isn’t necessary; didn’t need to = it wasn’t necessary (so she didn’t); needn’t have done = she did it, but it wasn’t necessary.
should (be doing) = điều nên làm lúc này; shouldn’t have done = việc đó sai (quá khứ); mustn’t = quan trọng là không được; doesn’t have to = không cần; didn’t need to = không cần (nên đã không làm); needn’t have done = đã làm nhưng không cần thiết.
Điểm ngữ pháp: mustn’t ↔ or she’ll be late.
mcq.key: Megan mustn’t oversleep, ___.|or she’ll be late for her interview

mcq.question: Nicky doesn’t have to get up yet ___.
mcq.a: if she’s not going to work today
mcq.b: when she was supposed to be studying
mcq.full: Nicky doesn’t have to get up yet if she’s not going to work today.
mcq.vi: Nicky chưa cần dậy nếu hôm nay cô ấy không đi làm.
mcq.expl:
should (be doing) = what is right now; shouldn’t have done = it was wrong (past); mustn’t = it is important not to; doesn’t have to = it isn’t necessary; didn’t need to = it wasn’t necessary (so she didn’t); needn’t have done = she did it, but it wasn’t necessary.
should (be doing) = điều nên làm lúc này; shouldn’t have done = việc đó sai (quá khứ); mustn’t = quan trọng là không được; doesn’t have to = không cần; didn’t need to = không cần (nên đã không làm); needn’t have done = đã làm nhưng không cần thiết.
Điểm ngữ pháp: doesn’t have to = không cần.
mcq.key: Nicky doesn’t have to get up yet ___.|if she’s not going to work today

mcq.question: Natalie didn’t need to hurry ___.
mcq.b: or she’ll be late for her interview
mcq.c: when she has an exam the next day
mcq.full: Natalie didn’t need to hurry because she wasn’t late.
mcq.vi: Natalie không cần vội vì cô ấy không bị muộn.
mcq.expl:
should (be doing) = what is right now; shouldn’t have done = it was wrong (past); mustn’t = it is important not to; doesn’t have to = it isn’t necessary; didn’t need to = it wasn’t necessary (so she didn’t); needn’t have done = she did it, but it wasn’t necessary.
should (be doing) = điều nên làm lúc này; shouldn’t have done = việc đó sai (quá khứ); mustn’t = quan trọng là không được; doesn’t have to = không cần; didn’t need to = không cần (nên đã không làm); needn’t have done = đã làm nhưng không cần thiết.
Điểm ngữ pháp: didn’t need to (quá khứ) ↔ because she wasn’t late.
mcq.key: Natalie didn’t need to hurry ___.|because she wasn’t late

mcq.question: Sharon needn’t have set the alarm clock ___.
mcq.a: because she woke up early anyway
mcq.b: but she’s too nervous to eat
mcq.c: or she’ll be late for her interview
mcq.full: Sharon needn’t have set the alarm clock because she woke up early anyway.
mcq.vi: Sharon lẽ ra chẳng cần đặt chuông báo thức vì đằng nào cô ấy cũng dậy sớm.
mcq.expl:
should (be doing) = what is right now; shouldn’t have done = it was wrong (past); mustn’t = it is important not to; doesn’t have to = it isn’t necessary; didn’t need to = it wasn’t necessary (so she didn’t); needn’t have done = she did it, but it wasn’t necessary.
should (be doing) = điều nên làm lúc này; shouldn’t have done = việc đó sai (quá khứ); mustn’t = quan trọng là không được; doesn’t have to = không cần; didn’t need to = không cần (nên đã không làm); needn’t have done = đã làm nhưng không cần thiết.
Điểm ngữ pháp: needn’t have done = đã làm nhưng không cần.
mcq.key: Sharon needn’t have set the alarm clock ___.|because she woke up early anyway

mcq.question: We’re doing our presentation next Monday. Can you email them right away? – ___ it now?
mcq.full: We’re doing our presentation next Monday. Can you email them right away? – Should I do it now?
mcq.vi: Chúng ta thuyết trình vào thứ Hai tới. Cậu email cho họ ngay được không? – Tôi có nên làm bây giờ không?
mcq.expl:
should / ought to = the right thing to do; should have done = it was right but you didn’t; don’t have to = not necessary; needn’t have done = it was done but unnecessary; must have done = I’m sure it happened; should be = expected to be.
should / ought to = điều đúng nên làm; should have done = lẽ ra nên làm nhưng đã không; don’t have to = không cần; needn’t have done = đã làm nhưng không cần; must have done = chắc chắn đã xảy ra; should be = lẽ ra phải (đang) ở.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Hỏi ý kiến → Should I …?
mcq.key: We’re doing our presentation next Monday. Can you email them right away? – ___ it now?|Should I do

mcq.question: Well, we ___ them earlier really.
mcq.full: Well, we should have told them earlier really.
mcq.vi: À, thật ra chúng ta lẽ ra nên báo họ sớm hơn.
mcq.expl:
should / ought to = the right thing to do; should have done = it was right but you didn’t; don’t have to = not necessary; needn’t have done = it was done but unnecessary; must have done = I’m sure it happened; should be = expected to be.
should / ought to = điều đúng nên làm; should have done = lẽ ra nên làm nhưng đã không; don’t have to = không cần; needn’t have done = đã làm nhưng không cần; must have done = chắc chắn đã xảy ra; should be = lẽ ra phải (đang) ở.
Điểm ngữ pháp: should have done = lẽ ra nên làm nhưng đã không.
mcq.key: Well, we ___ them earlier really.|should have told

mcq.question: I haven’t had an email about the presentation. Do you think I ___ call them?
mcq.full: I haven’t had an email about the presentation. Do you think I ought to call them?
mcq.vi: Tôi chưa nhận email về buổi thuyết trình. Cậu nghĩ tôi có nên gọi cho họ không?
mcq.expl:
should / ought to = the right thing to do; should have done = it was right but you didn’t; don’t have to = not necessary; needn’t have done = it was done but unnecessary; must have done = I’m sure it happened; should be = expected to be.
should / ought to = điều đúng nên làm; should have done = lẽ ra nên làm nhưng đã không; don’t have to = không cần; needn’t have done = đã làm nhưng không cần; must have done = chắc chắn đã xảy ra; should be = lẽ ra phải (đang) ở.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Do you think I ought to …? = có nên không.
mcq.key: I haven’t had an email about the presentation. Do you think I ___ call them?|ought to

mcq.question: Do you think I ought to call them? – No, you ___. It’s probably not relevant to your research area.
mcq.full: Do you think I ought to call them? – No, you don’t have to. It’s probably not relevant to your research area.
mcq.vi: Cậu nghĩ tôi có nên gọi cho họ không? – Không, cậu không cần. Có lẽ nó không liên quan đến lĩnh vực nghiên cứu của cậu.
mcq.expl:
should / ought to = the right thing to do; should have done = it was right but you didn’t; don’t have to = not necessary; needn’t have done = it was done but unnecessary; must have done = I’m sure it happened; should be = expected to be.
should / ought to = điều đúng nên làm; should have done = lẽ ra nên làm nhưng đã không; don’t have to = không cần; needn’t have done = đã làm nhưng không cần; must have done = chắc chắn đã xảy ra; should be = lẽ ra phải (đang) ở.
Điểm ngữ pháp: don’t have to = không cần (≠ mustn’t = không được).
mcq.key: Do you think I ought to call them? – No, you ___. It’s probably not relevant to your research area.|don’t have to

mcq.question: I’ve come early in case you wanted help to get the room ready. But I see I ___, you’ve got everything organised!
mcq.full: I’ve come early in case you wanted help to get the room ready. But I see I needn’t have bothered, you’ve got everything organised!
mcq.vi: Tôi đến sớm phòng khi cậu cần giúp chuẩn bị phòng. Nhưng hóa ra tôi chẳng cần phải bận tâm, cậu đã sắp xếp xong hết rồi!
mcq.expl:
should / ought to = the right thing to do; should have done = it was right but you didn’t; don’t have to = not necessary; needn’t have done = it was done but unnecessary; must have done = I’m sure it happened; should be = expected to be.
should / ought to = điều đúng nên làm; should have done = lẽ ra nên làm nhưng đã không; don’t have to = không cần; needn’t have done = đã làm nhưng không cần; must have done = chắc chắn đã xảy ra; should be = lẽ ra phải (đang) ở.
Điểm ngữ pháp: needn’t have done = đã làm nhưng không cần.
mcq.key: I’ve come early in case you wanted help to get the room ready. But I see I ___, you’ve got everything organised!|needn’t have bothered

mcq.question: She didn’t get an email from you. – Oh, dear. Robbie ___ the email to the wrong address.
mcq.full: She didn’t get an email from you. – Oh, dear. Robbie must have sent the email to the wrong address.
mcq.vi: Cô ấy không nhận được email của cậu. – Ôi trời. Robbie chắc đã gửi email nhầm địa chỉ.
mcq.expl:
should / ought to = the right thing to do; should have done = it was right but you didn’t; don’t have to = not necessary; needn’t have done = it was done but unnecessary; must have done = I’m sure it happened; should be = expected to be.
should / ought to = điều đúng nên làm; should have done = lẽ ra nên làm nhưng đã không; don’t have to = không cần; needn’t have done = đã làm nhưng không cần; must have done = chắc chắn đã xảy ra; should be = lẽ ra phải (đang) ở.
Điểm ngữ pháp: must have done = chắc chắn đã xảy ra.
mcq.key: She didn’t get an email from you. – Oh, dear. Robbie ___ the email to the wrong address.|must have sent

mcq.question: Where is he now? He ___ here.
mcq.full: Where is he now? He should be here.
mcq.vi: Giờ cậu ấy đâu? Cậu ấy lẽ ra phải ở đây.
mcq.expl:
should / ought to = the right thing to do; should have done = it was right but you didn’t; don’t have to = not necessary; needn’t have done = it was done but unnecessary; must have done = I’m sure it happened; should be = expected to be.
should / ought to = điều đúng nên làm; should have done = lẽ ra nên làm nhưng đã không; don’t have to = không cần; needn’t have done = đã làm nhưng không cần; must have done = chắc chắn đã xảy ra; should be = lẽ ra phải (đang) ở.
Điểm ngữ pháp: should be = lẽ ra phải (kỳ vọng).
mcq.key: Where is he now? He ___ here.|should be

mcq.question: I don’t know. He ___ we’re doing this presentation. He’s so unreliable!
mcq.full: I don’t know. He must have forgotten we’re doing this presentation. He’s so unreliable!
mcq.vi: Tôi không biết. Cậu ấy chắc đã quên là chúng ta thuyết trình hôm nay. Cậu ấy thật không đáng tin!
mcq.expl:
should / ought to = the right thing to do; should have done = it was right but you didn’t; don’t have to = not necessary; needn’t have done = it was done but unnecessary; must have done = I’m sure it happened; should be = expected to be.
should / ought to = điều đúng nên làm; should have done = lẽ ra nên làm nhưng đã không; don’t have to = không cần; needn’t have done = đã làm nhưng không cần; must have done = chắc chắn đã xảy ra; should be = lẽ ra phải (đang) ở.
Điểm ngữ pháp: must have done = chắc chắn đã.
mcq.key: I don’t know. He ___ we’re doing this presentation. He’s so unreliable!|must have forgotten

mcq.question: Oh no – my phone’s dead. I ___ find my charger straight away!
mcq.full: Oh no – my phone’s dead. I must find my charger straight away!
mcq.vi: Ôi không – điện thoại hết pin rồi. Tôi phải tìm cục sạc ngay!
mcq.expl:
must = necessary / important; mustn’t = important not to; needn’t = not necessary; should(n’t) = (not) the right thing to do; should(n’t) have done = past criticism or regret.
must = cần / quan trọng; mustn’t = không được; needn’t = không cần; should(n’t) = (không) nên; should(n’t) have done = phê phán hoặc hối tiếc về quá khứ.
Điểm ngữ pháp: must = cần thiết.
mcq.key: Oh no – my phone’s dead. I ___ find my charger straight away!|must

mcq.question: You ___ finish that essay tonight if you’re too tired. Midday tomorrow is the deadline.
mcq.full: You needn’t finish that essay tonight if you’re too tired. Midday tomorrow is the deadline.
mcq.vi: Bạn không cần hoàn thành bài luận tối nay nếu mệt quá. Trưa mai mới là hạn chót.
mcq.expl:
must = necessary / important; mustn’t = important not to; needn’t = not necessary; should(n’t) = (not) the right thing to do; should(n’t) have done = past criticism or regret.
must = cần / quan trọng; mustn’t = không được; needn’t = không cần; should(n’t) = (không) nên; should(n’t) have done = phê phán hoặc hối tiếc về quá khứ.
Điểm ngữ pháp: needn’t = không cần.
mcq.key: You ___ finish that essay tonight if you’re too tired. Midday tomorrow is the deadline.|needn’t

mcq.question: What are you doing here? ___ you be at college?
mcq.full: What are you doing here? Shouldn’t you be at college?
mcq.vi: Bạn làm gì ở đây vậy? Chẳng phải bạn phải ở trường sao?
mcq.expl:
must = necessary / important; mustn’t = important not to; needn’t = not necessary; should(n’t) = (not) the right thing to do; should(n’t) have done = past criticism or regret.
must = cần / quan trọng; mustn’t = không được; needn’t = không cần; should(n’t) = (không) nên; should(n’t) have done = phê phán hoặc hối tiếc về quá khứ.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Shouldn’t you be …? = lẽ ra phải.
mcq.key: What are you doing here? ___ you be at college?|Shouldn’t

mcq.question: He really ___ have told his brother about this present. It was supposed to be a secret.
mcq.full: He really shouldn’t have told his brother about this present. It was supposed to be a secret.
mcq.vi: Anh ấy thật không nên kể với em trai về món quà này. Nó đáng lẽ là bí mật.
mcq.expl:
must = necessary / important; mustn’t = important not to; needn’t = not necessary; should(n’t) = (not) the right thing to do; should(n’t) have done = past criticism or regret.
must = cần / quan trọng; mustn’t = không được; needn’t = không cần; should(n’t) = (không) nên; should(n’t) have done = phê phán hoặc hối tiếc về quá khứ.
Điểm ngữ pháp: shouldn’t have done = lẽ ra không nên.
mcq.key: He really ___ have told his brother about this present. It was supposed to be a secret.|shouldn’t

mcq.question: You ___ pay to go into this exhibition because I’ve got my membership card with me.
mcq.full: You needn’t pay to go into this exhibition because I’ve got my membership card with me.
mcq.vi: Bạn không cần trả tiền vào triển lãm này vì tôi có thẻ hội viên.
mcq.expl:
must = necessary / important; mustn’t = important not to; needn’t = not necessary; should(n’t) = (not) the right thing to do; should(n’t) have done = past criticism or regret.
